TOOLING BURST T4s-r1 — the exporter crashes with G2 kits registered: `NameError: name '_write_g2_component' is not defined` (export/godot_import.py line ~1360, `_write_vfx_kits`: `if has_g2: _write_g2_component(out)`) — PACK CS-pack-v28 FAILED on it (Run C-5, E3; conductor R-C5-57). task_id "T4s-r1". Small, surgical.

Read ONLY, in this order:
1. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/SPEC.md — § 0, § 1, § 7 rows T4b (G1 component emission — the pattern), T4s (your contract).
2. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/BURST_RULES.md (the TOOLING row).
3. export/godot_import.py (find `_write_g1_component` and every `_write_g2_*` / `g2_thrown_field` emission you wrote in T4s — the component scene + script emission exists under some other name or was never wired; the call site expects `_write_g2_component(out)`), runs/C-5/t3/T4s/acceptance.json + README.md (your own record: which fixture your headless import used — it evidently did not run the full exporter with the two G2 kits registered in kits_v9.json), runs/C-5/vfx_kits/kits_v9.json (13 kits), tests/test_godot_import.py, tests/test_vfx_picker.py (extend only).
Do not read anything else. No web. No agents. No image generation. No pip install. stdlib + Pillow + numpy + scipy ONLY; Godot for the headless import proof.

FIX: define/wire `_write_g2_component(out)` so the full exporter run `python3 -B -m export.godot_import --cells runs/C-3/cells_v7 --out <tmp>/godot --parallax runs/C-5/artifacts/CS-parallax-in-v10 --vfx-kits runs/C-5/vfx_kits/kits_v9.json --sockets runs/C-3/sockets_v2.json --props runs/C-5/artifacts/CS-props-v24` exits 0 with all 13 kits, emits scenes/vfx/g2_thrown_field.tscn + its script exactly as T4s intended, and the headless import of the result exits 0 with no script errors; add ONE test that runs the full exporter with the current kits_v9.json (13 kits) into a temp dir and asserts exit 0 + the G2 scene present (so a missing emitter can never pass again); the eleven non-G2 kits' export files byte-identical to the T4s freeze.
ACCEPTANCE (runs/C-5/t3/T4s-r1/acceptance.json): the full-exporter exit code and file list; headless import exit 0; byte identity table; in-sandbox suite reds named.

DO NOT touch: lane/, bible/, fixtures/, briefs/, SPEC.md, BURST_RULES.md, REGISTER_CARD.md, JUDGE_RUBRIC.md, MANIFEST.sha256, receipt.schema.json, transcribe.schema.json, oracle/, export/replay.py, export/effect_kit.py, any test file except the two named (extend only), anything under runs/ except runs/C-5/t3/T4s-r1/. Do not run git. Temporary files ONLY under runs/C-5/t3/T4s-r1/. Write out/files.json listing every file you changed with sha256.
RETURN: the receipt (task_id "T4s-r1"): files = every changed path with sha256; images = 0 (INTEGER); calls_used; status DELIVERED / DELIVERED_WITH_CONCERNS / FAILED with concerns listed honestly.
